question: What is the default failsafe action on the DJI Matrice 30T if the aircraft and controller disconnect?

intake.focus: loss of control link - default failsafe action
intake.reason: question about what the DJI Matrice 30T manual/incident guidance prescribes for loss of control link (signal loss) and what action the aircraft takes

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: When a loss of control link is suspected, try to reestablish the control link connection, and if unsuccessful, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. FAA guidance: If the hazard occurs over people, describe it as loss of control link over people. DJI Matrice 30T manual: The default failsafe action is RTH; failsafe will be triggered (default setting is RTH). DJI Matrice 30T manual: If the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft may enter ATTI mode and will automatically land; if the Home Point was recorded, the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH and continue RTH even if the controller reconnects.
